content.short: Cropper Finance provides a Solana-native yield farming protocol leveraging Serum's order book.
content.description: Cropper Finance, established in 2021 by Arthur C, Quentin Cropper, Fabrice Fabrice, and Victor Cropper, is designed as a Solana-native Automated Market Maker. By leveraging the Serum order book, it enables users and traders to farm a range of tokens and earn yields. For projects, Cropper Finance provides a means to inject liquidity, set the terms of their yields, and discover a ready yield-farming market for their assets. The approach centers on enabling liquidity and yield options for both traders and projects.
